CustomField.description: Apex class the inbound scheduler launches for this object (e.g. AccountInboundBatch). Like Outbox_Batch_Class__c it must be a distinct concrete class name, because AsyncApexJob cannot expose constructor arguments and the overlap guard keys on ApexClass.Name. Blank means the object is never polled -- a second, independent guard alongside Inbound_Active__c.
CustomField.label: Inbound Batch Class
